missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ресторан' is the nominative subject of 'открылся'. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A natural way to announce a new place.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Ресторан' is the accusative object of 'выбрали'; as a masculine inanimate noun it matches the nominative. 'Хороший' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after negation. 'Ресторана' is the genitive form required after 'нет'. The phrase 'рядом с домом' sets the location. A clean model for saying something is absent.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В ресторан' uses the accusative after 'в' to express motion toward a destination. 'Вечером' gives the time. The core go-somewhere pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В ресторане' uses the prepositional 'ресторане' after 'в' to mark location, not motion. 'Дорогом' is the agreeing masculine prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'В ресторане' marks where he works. 'Поваром' is the instrumental naming his role with 'работать'. A frequent workplace pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Рестораном' is the instrumental governed by 'довольны'. 'Новым' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A natural way to express satisfaction.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Ресторанов' is the genitive plural required after 'много'. 'Хороших' is the agreeing plural genitive adjective. Good for talking about quantity.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Рестораны' is the nominative plural, the subject of the sentence. 'Эти' agrees in the plural and 'популярны' is a short-form predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Из ресторана' uses the genitive after 'из' to express motion out of a place. 'Поздно' gives the time. The natural counterpart to 'в ресторан'.
